title: The Stairs to Adulthood May Not Always Lead Up
overview: Kagura has a boyfriend!! What unspeakable things will happen to him who appears before the obsessively nosey, restlessly agitated Umibozu and Gintoki!?

title: My Bald Dad, My Light-Haired Dad, and My Dad's Glasses
overview: Gintoki and Umibozu go all-out to stop Kagura's marriage from happening.

title: A Bowl of Ramen
overview: Katsura, upon hearing Ikumatsu's story about an old man who used to visit her restaurant every New Year's Eve, enlists the Odd Jobs' help to look for him.

title: A Family
overview: The gang discover the truth behind the old man and look to reunite him with Ikumatsu and her ramen.

title: Life, Death, and Shades / All the Answers Can Be Found in the Field
overview: Hasegawa has a life-or-death encounter with assassins, and the Shinsengumi and Mimawarigumi compete over solving a fictional case.

title: 3000 Leagues in Search of a Scabbard
overview: The Odd Jobs encounter a strange sword at Tetsuko's smithy, and it grows attached (quite literally) to Gintoki's behind!

title: The Super Sadist and the Super Sadist
overview: Kusanagi reveals the details of an old wound he received at the hands of the cursed sword, Maganagi, as Gintoki and Okita get ready for their duel. Meanwhile, Hijikata investigates Senbe the Manslayer.

title: The Strongest Sword, and the Dullest Ass
overview: The Excaliburling story reaches its climax as Maganagi takes over Okita's body and reveals the truth to Kusanagi. How will Gintoki respond?

title: Wash Your Hands Before a Handshake
overview: As group units take over the idol industry, Terakado Tsu must adapt or fall behind the times. But the idol she forms a combo unit with is... Kagura?

title: Diamonds are Unscratchable
overview: Boogie Diamonds 48 has to deal with the sudden arrival of Galaxy Kingdom Bitches 48, who challenge them for the spot of Edo's top idol!

title: An Idol's Badge of Honor
overview: The battle at the Oedo Dome heats up as the fans waver between the two groups, but Otsu is still holed up indoors. Will she fade away, or will Shinpachi and gang rekindle her passion?

title: The Line Between Godlike Games and Shitty Games is Paper-Thin
overview: In the first half, Gintoki decides that as protagonist, he can't sit and do nothing as a Gintama game is released. He takes matters into his own hands as Odd Jobs looks to produce a super hit. In the second, Shinpachi buys a new pair of glasses that get him rather high spirits...

title: Guardian Spirits Are Also a Part of the Soul
overview: The Kabuki District Sports Meet begins, and Shinpachi bears witness to the influence guardian spirits have on such events. Will he be able to fight through it and help Odd Jobs win the cash prize?
